description: For each client, return which remaining Q4 deadlines hit them, why (e.g. 'age 74 with a Rollover IRA', 'on extension with a SEP IRA'), and whether an open item already covers it. Use initials or ids, not names; inputs are not stored.

as_of.description: Date to check from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today, US Eastern.

accounts.description: Account types, e.g. Traditional IRA, Rollover IRA, SEP IRA, SIMPLE IRA, Inherited IRA, Roth IRA, Individual, Joint

id.description: Client id or initials, e.g. C-2087 or MB

name: check_clients
title: Check clients against deadlines
